elsewhere.note: Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness’ sake, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

“The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal the broken hearted, to proclaim release to…

Even as it is written, “For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.”
